chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) who said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated from Ya'qub ibn Yazid, from Ziyad ibn Marwan, from Abu Waki', from Abu Ishaq, from Al-Harith who said: The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The dinar and the dirham destroyed those who were before you, and they will destroy you.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the dinar and dirham causing destruction?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq attributes this saying to the Prophet via Imam Ali, framing gold and silver not merely as currency but as spiritual corrupters that led to the downfall of earlier nations. This highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on how material attachment to wealth distracts from divine remembrance and leads to societal decay, a theme reinforced by the warning against hoarding gold and silver in the Quran.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 2-37 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Sa’ed ibn Abdullah quoted on the authority of Yaqoob ibn Yazid, on the authority of Zyad ibn Marvan, on the authority of Abi Vaki’a, on the authority of Abi Ishaq, on the authority of Al-Harith, on the authority of the Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali (MGB) that God’s Prophet (MGB) said, “
Silver and gold money destroyed those before you and they will destroy you, too.”
